sentences.text: There are totally 5 accused in this case and the case in respect of A1 to A4 was split up in S.C.Nos.87 and 88 of 2023 and the same has been disposed of.
3. On perusal of the allegations, it can be seen that a minor girl by name Bharathi, was taken away from the Tuition Centre.
It seems to be the elopement on love affair.
However, since the allegation of 376 of IPC is also made, the case is pending.
The main case is in trial, where it can be seen that the mother of the victim and the victim turned hostile.
The victim has given a statement that she doesn't want to pursue the case further.

4. Considering the over all facts and circumstances of the case and also the fact that it is in the guise of love affair; the victim girl has also now attained majority; she has moved to the marital life in a different family and if this case further proceeds, it would cause prejudice even to the victim, I am of the view that no useful purpose would be served in keeping this matter pending.

5.Accordingly, the case in PRC.Nos.3 & 4 of 2023 on the file of https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis (
